facts.en: Completed a library services certificate at Fictional Robinglass College in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构知更玻璃学院完成图书馆服务证书课程。

facts.en: Paid part-time library desk assistant at Fictional Duskbrook Library from 2021-01 to 2026-08, contracted for 20 hours per week.
facts.zh: 2021-01 至 2026-08 在虚构暮溪图书馆任有薪兼职柜台助理，合同为每周 20 小时。

facts.en: At the library, maintained room-booking requests and helped visitors locate reserved materials.
facts.zh: 在图书馆维护房间预订请求，并协助访客查找预留资料。

facts.en: Unpaid rehearsal organizer for Fictional Meadowbell Community Choir from 2023-09 to 2026-06.
facts.zh: 2023-09 至 2026-06 为虚构草铃社区合唱团担任无薪排练组织员。

facts.en: The choir activity normally occupied one evening each week and was separate from the paid library contract.
facts.zh: 合唱团活动通常每周占用一个晚间，与有薪图书馆合同分开。

facts.en: Confirmed rehearsal-room bookings and checked the conductor’s and accompanist’s availability.
facts.zh: 确认排练室预订，并核对指挥及伴奏者的可用时间。

facts.en: Sent rehearsal reminders, recorded absences and relayed schedule changes approved by the conductor.
facts.zh: 发送排练提醒、记录缺席，并转达指挥批准的排期变更。

facts.en: Distributed conductor-approved score copies supplied by the choir committee and collected them after term.
facts.zh: 分发合唱团委员会提供、经指挥批准的乐谱副本，并在学期结束后收回。

facts.en: The committee handled copying permissions; the candidate did not obtain or grant music rights.
facts.zh: 复制许可由委员会处理；候选人不取得或授予音乐权利。

facts.en: Prepared a rehearsal attendance workbook for the 2025 spring term.
facts.zh: 为 2025 年春季学期准备排练出席工作簿。

facts.en: The workbook recorded 26 registered singers and 174 singer-attendances across 8 rehearsals, including repeat attendance by the same singers.
facts.zh: 该工作簿记录 26 名注册歌手，以及 8 次排练中的 174 人次出席，其中包含同一歌手重复出席。

facts.en: Personally designed the absence-note and borrowed-score columns; the conductor set rehearsal priorities.
facts.zh: 个人设计缺席备注及借用乐谱列；排练优先事项由指挥设定。

facts.en: Uses shared calendars, spreadsheet counts and email lists for choir administration.
facts.zh: 使用共享日历、电子表格计数及邮件名单处理合唱团行政事务。

facts.en: Played conductor-supplied backing tracks through a portable speaker during 3 section rehearsals; no mixing desk was used.
facts.zh: 在 3 次声部分组排练中，通过便携音箱播放指挥提供的伴奏音轨；未使用调音台。

facts.en: Attended a non-award beginner singing workshop in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年参加不授予资格的初学者歌唱工作坊。

facts.en: Created illustrated labels for score folders in 2024 as a voluntary choir project.
facts.zh: 2024 年作为合唱团志愿项目，为乐谱文件夹制作图解标签。

facts.en: Helped arrange chairs and the refreshment table at the choir’s informal sharing evening in 2025-06.
facts.zh: 2025-06 在合唱团非正式分享晚会上协助摆放座椅及茶点桌。

facts.en: Made a personal playlist of invented practice-song titles in 2023, with no public release or commercial audience.
facts.zh: 2023 年制作个人虚构练习曲目名称播放清单，未公开发行，亦无商业受众。

facts.en: Enjoys making hand-bound notebooks.
facts.zh: 爱好制作手工装订笔记本。

facts.en: No paid choral-management role, conducting appointment or live sound-mixing experience is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录有薪合唱团管理岗位、指挥任命或现场调音经历。
